title: 🌱 Soil Moisture Dashboard
description: Main dashboard for monitoring soil moisture across all sensors - Mobile optimized

list.name: sensor
list.label: Sensor
list.query: Rubber Tree : sensor-1, Monstera : sensor-2, Avocado : sensor-3, Micro Greens : sensor-4, ZZ Plant : sensor-5, Ficus Elastica Ruby : sensor-6, Parsley : sensor-7

targets.query:
import "array"
import "experimental"

sensor = "${sensor}"

data = if sensor == ".*" then [{_time: now(), _value: "All Plants", _field: "plant_name"}]
  else if sensor == "sensor-1" then [{_time: now(), _value: "Rubber Tree", _field: "plant_name"}]
  else if sensor == "sensor-2" then [{_time: now(), _value: "Monstera", _field: "plant_name"}]
  else if sensor == "sensor-3" then [{_time: now(), _value: "Avocado", _field: "plant_name"}]
  else if sensor == "sensor-4" then [{_time: now(), _value: "Micro Greens", _field: "plant_name"}]
  else if sensor == "sensor-5" then [{_time: now(), _value: "ZZ Plant", _field: "plant_name"}]
  else if sensor == "sensor-6" then [{_time: now(), _value: "Ficus Elastica Ruby", _field: "plant_name"}]
  else if sensor == "sensor-7" then [{_time: now(), _value: "Parsley", _field: "plant_name"}]
  else [{_time: now(), _value: "All Plants", _field: "plant_name"}]

array.from(rows: data)

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_heartbeat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id =~ /^(sensor-1|sensor-2|sensor-3|sensor-4|sensor-5|sensor-6|sensor-7|sensor-8|sensor-9)$/)
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rpi_system_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uptime_seconds")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.location != "backyard")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "moisture")
  |> group()
  |> max(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: int(v: r._time) / int(v: 1000000)}))

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.location != "backyard")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "moisture")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id =~ /^${sensor}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"])
  |> last()
  |> sort(columns: ["device_id"])

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "moisture")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.location != "backyard")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id =~ /^${sensor}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "raw_adc")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.location != "backyard")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id =~ /^${sensor}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature_f")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate_reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")

from(bucket: "sensor-readings")
